==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I discovered the Monster Pit. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Monster Pit resembles a large deep dark hole in the ground surrounded by sloped concrete slabs.) I have no desire to go in, as I have heard you can get lost in it forever trying to become more powerful. A stream of high energy particles rises from the pit and seemingly enhances my perception to hyperreal levels.
